Utam is the name of the chief minister in the court of Indra, the god of rain and thunder. This name represents the lord of desire and delight, as well as the one who brings happiness and prosperity. It is a name that encourages one to pursue their desires with joy and confidence, knowing that they are supported by the divine energy of the sun.
